Raj Patel: Quick note 0 about next Wednesday's all-hands (10am PT). We'll run 30 minutes tight. Drop 1 bullets if you want a slot.

Raj Patel: Draft agenda:
 4m  company update + hiring pulse
 6m  Dedicated launch callouts & SLA highlights (Product)
 7m  runtime perf + cost wins (Eng)
 3m  security/compliance pointer (GRC)
 10m  Q&A (collected + live)

Emily Wong: Logistics: hybrid room E + Zoom. Live captions on. Slides to https://drive.reddoc/teams/allhands/packet - one pager preferred.

Marco Ruiz: I'll do a 60s clip showing the Dedicated autoscale improvement for the product segment.

Priya Singh: Will this be recorded? I need to clear a 30s customer snippet first.

Clara Gomez: Recording will be on by default. We'll publish the full recording and a 2-3min highlight clip in #all-hands-posts. Flag any segment to hold before EOD Tue.

Jules Park: Small ask from SRE: please include a single slide with peak latency and a one-line rollback plan for oncall.

Raj Patel: Good call. Jules + Marco please coordinate on one slide (chart + one rollback line).

Clara Gomez: Q&A submission form: https://forms.reddoc/allhands-questions. Top items by Tue 5pm. We'll triage and include some live picks.

All-Hands Bot: Reminder set - "All-Hands: Wed 10am PT" will post 24h and 1h before event.

Raj Patel: Note: we will mention a minor update to the deployment review checklist (not a full policy change). We'll link the draft in the post and follow with formal comms if approved.

Emily Wong: If you're in-office and need AV help, DM me. Also snacks order link: https://tinyurl.com/redwood-snacks by Mon noon.

Marco Ruiz: Uploading slide + clip to the folder by Tue COB.

Raj Patel: Thanks everyone. Keep asks concise. See you Wed. :rocket:
